name: Alleghany
gaps: Parcels are NC/Alleghany Parcels (PRIMARY geometry + owner + deed) (https://www.webgis.net/arcgis/rest/services/NC/Alleghany/MapServer/11). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 3628 rows; 3613 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
Pass 2 enrichment is from card pass2 (tax gap, sale partial). Pass 2 counted 173 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 tax status is gap. Scrubbed or missing tax values were not copied off the parcel layer.
Pass 2 sale: DEED_DATE (string) only; price on ITSPublicAL AppraisalCard PDF SALES DATA grid.
Pass 2 tax join matched 3559 of 3613 parcel ids.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
